result.instructions: Oh My Second Brain exposes write, search, link, status, and doctor tools. oms_write and doctor repair operations are gated by a verified vault target (a vault inferred from the current directory is refused); oms_write also enforces vault confinement and contract validation.

tools.name: oms_write
tools.title: Oh My Second Brain write
tools.description: Write a vault note through the kernel-owned .oms contract.

tools.name: oms_search
tools.title: Oh My Second Brain search
tools.description: Retrieve vault context, semantic search, ontology, and selected documents. `op` selects the operation.

tools.name: oms_link
tools.title: Oh My Second Brain link
tools.description: Suggest or apply wikilinks; `op` is suggest or apply.

tools.name: oms_status
tools.title: Oh My Second Brain status
tools.description: Read-only health and statistics for the active vault.

tools.name: oms_doctor
tools.title: Oh My Second Brain doctor
tools.description: Diagnose or repair the vault; `op` selects the operation.
